claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: KF-38789 is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM over 5 days, as its annotated P-selectin (SELP) inhibitory activity has no direct cytotoxic mechanism in cancer cell lines that generally lack P-selectin and no dominant off-target cytotoxicity is expected.
